description: Use this to show what is in the customer's teas.co.uk basket, with the live subtotal and a delivery estimate. Prices and stock are read again on every call. basket_id is only for hosts that do not identify the customer: pass the one an earlier basket tool returned. A basket is kept for 35 days after its last change. An unknown basket_id, or a basket never filled, comes back empty (no lines, no delivery price) rather than as an error. To add products use add_to_basket, to change quantities use update_basket, and to pay use checkout_link.
